notes.title: NOW MULTIPLAYER!
notes.content:
Thank you very much to those of you who continue to play Run Or Die regularly!! We have launched Multiplayer!! Now you can play with your friends with no player limit!

[previewyoutube=JWGkacL9dNw;full][/previewyoutube]


 Multiplayer (P2P, Invite unlimited players)
 Create checkpoint (key C)
 Spawn on checkpoint (Key R)
 Push friends (Left Mouse Button)
 New Interface
 New logo
 Fix movement vehicles back to initial position after finish
